synthesis:draft.headline: Latest available AEMO POE50 forecast for VIC1 for half-hour ending 2026-08-19T23:30:00Z (2026-08-20 09:30 AEST (UTC+1000)) was 6403.0 MW.
summary: The latest public AEMO POE50 forecast available as-of 2026-08-19T21:00:00Z for VIC1 for target_end_utc 2026-08-19T23:30:00Z (target_end_local "2026-08-20 09:30 AEST (UTC+1000)") is 6403.0 MW (evidence ev0535).
An earlier public forecast run (issued 2026-08-17) had POE50 = 6281.0 MW for the same target interval (evidence ev0034).

The forecast-versus-actual comparison over the 24 half-hours around the event window had mean absolute error MAE = 8.0 MW (evidence ev0592); however, only one paired interval was provably public by the as-of time and many target intervals lacked provably-public actuals by 2026-08-19T21:00:00Z.

Earlier POE50 forecast for the same interval (issued 2026-08-17)
Mean absolute error (MAE) reported for the forecast window

possible_explanations.statement: AEMO forecasts may have been updated between the 2026-08-17 run and the 2026-08-19 run (POE50 changed from 6281.0 MW [ev0034] to 6403.0 MW [ev0535]), which might reflect updated input assumptions such as weather.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Compare successive forecast-run metadata and any accompanying forecast commentary or market notices published before 2026-08-19T21:00:00Z to see whether updated weather inputs or other assumptions were stated.

possible_explanations.statement: Cold weather could have been expected by meteorological services but not mentioned in AEMO market notices accessible for VIC1 in the searched window.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Retrieve contemporaneous weather-forecast products or meteorological advisories valid before 2026-08-19T21:00:00Z, and search AEMO market notices and forecast commentary published before 2026-08-19T21:00:00Z for mentions of cold conditions.

uncertainties: No AEMO market notice for VIC1 in the event window was returned by retrieve_public_evidence when searched for the as-of 2026-08-19T21:00:00Z view (retrieve_public_evidence reported no notice held for this region and window).
Weather context (retrospective NASA POWER) was not usable in an as-of view and so contemporaneous weather-forecast data were not available from the tools for 2026-08-19T21:00:00Z.

Many forecast target intervals (including 2026-08-19T23:30:00Z) did not have provably-public actual operational demand values by the as-of time, limiting direct forecast/realised comparison for those intervals.
